narrative.intro: Central Plateau Cleanup obligated $454M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Central Plateau Cleanup won 8 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $56.8M. Obligations rose from $441M in FY21 to $605M in FY23, then moderated to $532M in FY24 and $558M in FY25 before settling at $454M in FY26. Obligations are down 18.6% year over year. The numbers are partial because FY2026 totals are fiscal year to date. This profile points to a multi-year cycle of higher peak spending in FY22 and FY23 followed by lower obligations in the most recent fiscal year, with relatively large average award values supporting the program-level workload.
